glosses: To express in a denomination (i.e., a monetary unit).

examples.text: Oil is denominated in dollars, so changes in the strength of the dollar affect oil prices everywhere.

glosses: Having a specific name or denomination; specified in the concrete as opposed to abstract; thus, 7 feet is a denominate quantity, while 7 is mere abstract quantity or number.
